theorems.name: Submission.rc_cc_countable_dense
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [SecondCountableTopology X] (K : Set X), IsCompact K → ∃ D : Set C_c(X, ℝ), D.Countable ∧ (∀ g ∈ D, tsupport g ⊆ K) ∧ ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ K → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ g ∈ D, ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
